title: Which EOCC services a Page and Field Configurator configuration maps follows the configurator's Mapper, and can be derived from its rows
statement: The Event Mapping a configuration needs is derived from its stored rows as EOCC_COMP_CONFIG:EventMapping:Mapper derives it: component PostBuild and SavePreChange (Standard; Masking PostBuild at 999); RowInit and RowInsert on each configured field's parent record (level 2/3 fields add their ancestor scrolls' records RowInit), numbered EOCC_ROWINITn/ROWINSERTn in order; PageActivate on configured and secondary pages when EOCC_PAGE_EVENT is Y; search and prompt field events; FieldChange on active sequences' criteria fields.

observations.observation: tools/lab/pfc-mapper-check.mts compared the derivation with every applied configuration's stored EOCC rows on HRDMO: DEPEND_BENEF (MASK), HR_JOB_DATA_SUM_FL, JOB_CODE_TBL (2 content references), PERSONAL_DATA (MASK), PYE_BANKACCT (MASK) match row for row; the other two were generated by older releases (separate finding).
